question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Fraudulent
solution:
The correct answer is: Option (2) i.e. "**Counterfeit"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Fraudulent"** refers to something intended to deceive others, typically by unjustifiably claiming or being credited with accomplishments or qualities. (**धोखाधड़ी**)

 
 
• **Example: **The company was accused of engaging in fraudulent activities that misled investors.
 
 
 
• **"Counterfeit" **means made in exact imitation of something valuable with the intention to deceive or defraud; it is fake or not genuine. (**नकली**)
 
 
• **Example: **She was caught trying to pay with a counterfeit $100 bill.
 
 
 
• Hence, the most appropriate synonym for **'Fraudulent'** is **'Counterfeit'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Counterfeit**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Genuine **(वास्तविक): Something that is authentic and real, not fake or copied.

 
 
• **Example:** The dealer confirmed that the painting was genuine and very valuable.
 
 
 
• **Unimaginative **(कल्पनाशील नहीं): Lacking creativity or innovation; not imaginative.
 
 
• **Example: **The plot of the movie was criticized for being dull and unimaginative.
 
 
 
• **Dissimilar** (भिन्न): Not alike or similar; different.
 
 
• **Example:** Despite being twins, their personalities are quite dissimilar.
